data.simulation_requirement: If Riverside University announces a 25% tuition increase next semester, how will students, faculty, media and government react over the following 3 days?

outline.title: Predicted Reaction to the Riverside Tuition Increase

data.markdown_content:
# Predicted Reaction to the Riverside Tuition Increase

> **Bottom line:** Opposition consolidates within 24 simulated hours and peaks in rounds 3–4, driven by students and alumni; the ministry signals a review.

## 1. How the debate unfolds

- **Hours 0–12:** Campus Daily breaks the story; students amplify it on both platforms.
- **Hours 12–36:** A rally is organised; *alumni* threaten to pause donations.
  - Faculty split: some defend cost pressures, others call for transparency.
- **Hours 36–72:** Attention decays but sentiment stays negative.

## 2. Key actors

| Actor | Stance | Influence |
|---|---|---|
| Lena Park | opposing | high |
| Ministry of Education | neutral | high |
| Prof. Ken Ito | supportive | medium |

## 3. Recommendations

1. Publish a cost breakdown before the next board meeting.
2. Pair the increase with an expanded need-based aid package.
3. Hold an open forum with student representatives.

---

Model confidence is moderate; see `actions.json` for raw evidence and [MiroFish](https://github.com/666ghj/MiroFish) for method.
